reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_reference_session`: Session malformed or absent from the topic-relevant source index. `incompatible_reference_session`: A session is supplied for the global sessions topic. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

session.description: Selected session, or null for the global session index.
